test_title: PYST 6: SSC Stenographer - English (Held On:18 Nov 2022 Shift 3)
subject: english
question:
Directions: Each item in this section consists of sentences with an underlined word followed by four words or group of words. Select the option that is opposite in meaning to the underlined word and mark your response on the answer sheet accordingly.

His __woeful__ eyes betrayed his feelings.
solution: The correct answer is **"cheerful."** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__ __ • The word** 'woeful'** means full of sadness or misery. (दुःख या कष्ट से भरा हुआ) • **Example**: *Her face was **woeful**__.* • The antonym of **'woeful'** is **'cheerful.'** • **"Cheerful"** means happy and optimistic. (प्रसन्‍न, प्रमुदित; हँसमुख) __ • **Example**:* Bhavna is always very **cheerful**__.* • So, the correct antonym to replace** 'woeful'** in the sentence is **'cheerful'. ** • The correct answer is Option 3. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** • Option 1 - **Bewailing** means to express deep sorrow or grief. It is not an antonym of 'woeful'. (गहरा दुःख व्यक्त करना) • Option 2 - **Plangent **means having a loud, reverberating sound. It is not an antonym of 'woeful'. (तेज़, गूँजती हुई ध्वनि होना) • Option 4 -** Agonised** means in a state of great physical or mental pain. It is not an antonym of 'woeful'. (किसी कठिन समस्‍या या परिस्थिति पर लंबे समय तक सोचना या चिंतित होना) 43:Tc09, The correct answer is **"impish."**
